title: B — STRICT PERSISTENCE AND LOAD BOUNDARY
outcome: B — STRICT PERSISTENCE AND LOAD BOUNDARY
acceptance: B — STRICT PERSISTENCE AND LOAD BOUNDARY, cap +550. Depends on A. Add registry/logical identity fields to both metadata builders and reconstruction plus an explicit required-row image operation within the primary writer. No production identity preparation or rotation caller. The strict operation validates all required session/delegation/metadata rows, exact content revision and ACK/readback; later ordinary snapshots must not overwrite committed identity state or resurrect retired operational fields. Unrelated persistence keeps its existing behavior. Acceptance subset: I3 load/missing/corrupt mapping; I4 partial write/commit/ACK/restart controls; I5 required-row retention; I7 closed disposable fixture. A failing required session must prevent the handled acknowledgement from committing. Include stale generic snapshot and session-deletion races. If this requires more than 550, divide storage/load from strict transaction machinery before proceeding; do not omit the latter.
